meta.description: Strictly valid JSON mapping of the 5-layer integrated ESG research plan to empirical literature evidence, establishing the causal logic chain from expected contributions to research questions and validated evidence.

research_questions: RQ1.1: How can Transformer-based architectures be optimized for bilingual ESG ABSA?
RQ1.3: How can regional calibration and ESG lexicons mitigate bias?

literature_references.title: LORAXBENCH: A Multitask, Multilingual Benchmark Suite for 20 Indonesian Languages
literature_references.relevance: Directly supports C1 and C3 by providing a benchmark for low-resource Indonesian languages, identifying performance discrepancies that justify the need for regional calibration (RQ1.3).

literature_references.title: Shared Path: Unraveling Memorization in Multilingual LLMs through Language Similarities
literature_references.relevance: Provides evidence for C3 and RQ1.1 by demonstrating that language similarity underpins cross-lingual transferability, validating the foundational multilingual design.

contributions: C8: Large-scale ESG LLM benchmark (30+ models)
research_questions: RQ2.1: To what extent does few-shot learning improve ESG granularity?
RQ2.2: How can long-context mechanisms enhance scalability?
RQ2.4: How can multi-LLM fusion reduce hallucination?

literature_references.title: Query-Focused Retrieval Heads Improve Long-Context Reasoning and Re-ranking
literature_references.relevance: Supports C13 and RQ2.2 by identifying specific attention heads responsible for long-context retrieval, enabling scalable document processing.

literature_references.title: TreeRare: Syntax Tree-Guided Retrieval and Reasoning for Knowledge-Intensive Question Answering
literature_references.relevance: Causally links to C13 and RQ2.1 by demonstrating how syntax tree traversal resolves localized uncertainty in complex, knowledge-intensive tasks.

research_questions: RQ3.1: How can symbolic reasoning be integrated using ESG ontologies?
RQ3.2: How can transparent outputs be ensured via reasoning graphs?
RQ3.3: How can implicit ESG claims be identified?

literature_references.title: LoCt-Instruct: An Automatic Pipeline for Constructing Datasets of Logical Continuous Instructions
literature_references.relevance: Justifies C7 and RQ3.1 by proposing a pipeline for multi-turn logical instructions that progressively deepens content, essential for neuro-symbolic alignment.

literature_references.title: OmniThink: Expanding Knowledge Boundaries in Machine Writing through Thinking
literature_references.relevance: Supports C4 and RQ3.2 by simulating iterative expansion and reflection to improve knowledge density and reasoning transparency.

research_questions: RQ4.1: How can XAI improve stakeholder trust in ESG outputs?
RQ4.5: Can tone–outcome mismatch reliably indicate greenwashing?

literature_references.title: MOSAIC: Modeling Social AI for Content Dissemination and Regulation in Multi-Agent Simulations
literature_references.relevance: Provides the causal framework for C11 and RQ4.5 by analyzing emergent deception behaviors and how agents determine content veracity in social simulations.

literature_references.title: Video-RTS: Rethinking Reinforcement Learning and Test-Time Scaling for Efficient and Enhanced Video Reasoning
literature_references.relevance: Supports C14 and RQ4.1 by utilizing output consistency and adaptive scaling to improve reasoning reliability and trust.

research_questions: RQ5.1: How can transparent and auditable outputs be ensured?
RQ5.2: How can reasoning quality and consistency be operationalized at scale?

literature_references.title: DatawiseAgent: A Notebook-Centric LLM Agent Framework for Adaptive and Robust Data Science Automation
literature_references.relevance: Supports C12 and RQ5.1 by providing a unified interaction representation for flexible long-horizon planning and robust recovery in open-source pipelines.

literature_references.title: SwarmAgentic: Towards Fully Automated Agentic System Generation via Swarm Intelligence
literature_references.relevance: Validates the deployment strategy (O5) by constructing agentic systems from scratch and self-optimizing collaboration for complex planning (RQ5.2).
